entities.summary: Conor Michael Sheary is an American professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the New York Rangers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was signed as an undrafted free agent by the Pittsburgh Penguins in 2014 and won back-to-back Stanley Cups in his first two seasons with the organization. Sheary has also played for the Buffalo Sabres, Washington Capitals, and Tampa Bay Lightning.
